questions.question: What does Playground do for child care centers?
questions.answer: Playground is child care management software built for multi-classroom, full-day center programs. It runs billing, classroom-level enrollment, ratios, staff scheduling, payroll, family communication, and licensing reporting from one platform.

questions.question: How do you run a child care center across multiple classrooms?
questions.answer: Run multiple classrooms from one system instead of separate spreadsheets. Playground tracks ratios live by classroom and age group and forecasts upcoming openings classroom by classroom.
